proposedLocalContractForDirectorAuthorsh.classification: NEW SPELL-LOCAL TEST_ONLY AUTHORING, NOT AN EXISTING SOURCE RULE; no value is adopted or asserted as a fact.

proposedLocalContractForDirectorAuthorsh.crateProfile: Director to provide or reject a fully explicit branch-local material/construction, current/max durability, defenses and damage thresholds/formula. No profile or numeric values are selected in this preflight.
proposedLocalContractForDirectorAuthorsh.breakage: Director to specify a deterministic break threshold and the exact surviving crate or fragment objects, including IDs, mass, dimensions/volume, landing positions and custody. Do not infer salvage or create unbound fragments.
proposedLocalContractForDirectorAuthorsh.contentsAndCustody: Contents remain unknown in the source state. Director-authored TEST_ONLY input must explicitly list each content item and its state, mass, position and ownership/custody, or explicitly designate an adopted test-only contents manifest. Absence of a contents field is never treated as empty.

directorRequest.question: Please review this preflight and either provide a complete, explicit W1-only Director-authored TEST_ONLY local contract (with source facts kept separate) or retain IE204-B02 and state the minimum actual-source evidence needed.
directorRequest.requestedOutput: If authoring the local test contract, give exact material/construction, current/max structural durability and defenses, deterministic 60ft/120ft object-impact values or formula, breakage threshold, complete crate/fragment identity and position outcomes, and explicit contents/custody input and settlement. Label all newly authored values TEST_ONLY. Include the exact owner-adoption scope required before any witness. If the contract cannot satisfy W1, retain the hold and state the minimum missing evidence.
directorRequest.afterReview: No witness construction until the Director has reviewed/issued exact terms and the owner has separately adopted them. If authorized later, produce only the minimum aftermath delta for affected branches; do not replay the six historical cases.
